question: Which genre has the most tracks?
generated_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM Genre AS T1 INNER JOIN Track AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId GROUP BY T1.GenreId, T1.Name ORDER BY COUNT(T2.TrackId) DESC, T1.Name ASC LIMIT 1

question: Which 5 artists have the most albums?
generated_sql:
SELECT T1.Name, COUNT(T2.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount
FROM Artist AS T1
JOIN Album AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId
GROUP BY T1.ArtistId, T1.Name
ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC, T1.Name ASC
LIMIT 5
